BEHIND
THE CHARACTER.

DOWNLOAD MY CV ↗

I'm Hiep, a 3D character artist with 3+ years of experience bringing characters into game worlds.

My work spans realistic and stylized characters, from sculpting and modeling to PBR texturing, lighting, and real-time asset preparation. I enjoy the space where a strong silhouette, thoughtful materials, and small details make a character feel alive.
